organizations.name: Indian Space Research Organisation
organizations.description: National space agency of India under the Department of Space, responsible for launch vehicles, satellite missions, and human spaceflight.

organizations.name: NewSpace India Limited
organizations.description: Commercial arm of ISRO enabling Indian industry participation and international commercial launches on PSLV, SSLV, and LVM3.

organizations.name: Skyroot Aerospace
organizations.description: Private aerospace manufacturer developing the Vikram series of small-lift launch vehicles; launched India's first private rocket, Vikram-S.

organizations.name: Agnikul Cosmos
organizations.description: Developer of the customizable Agnibaan orbital launch vehicle powered by 3D-printed semi-cryogenic Agnilet engines and India's first private launchpad at SHAR.

organizations.name: Pixxel
organizations.description: Space data company building a constellation of high-resolution hyperspectral Earth observation satellites (Firefly & Honeybee).

organizations.name: Bellatrix Aerospace
organizations.description: In-space propulsion and orbital transfer vehicle (OTV) company developing green monopropellant, Hall-effect, and microwave plasma thrusters.

organizations.name: Dhruva Space
organizations.description: Full-stack space engineering company providing modular satellite platforms, orbital deployers, and Ground Station-as-a-Service (GSaaS).

organizations.name: Digantara
organizations.description: Space situational awareness (SSA) startup deploying space-based electro-optical sensors to track orbital debris and resident space objects.

organizations.name: GalaxEye
organizations.description: Multi-sensor imaging startup combining Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and optical payloads on the Drishti satellite mission for all-weather Earth observation.

launch_vehicles.name: PSLV
launch_vehicles.description: Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV), ISRO's workhorse 4-stage launcher alternating solid and liquid stages for SSO, LEO, and interplanetary missions.

launch_vehicles.name: GSLV Mk II
launch_vehicles.description: Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle Mk II featuring an indigenous cryogenic upper stage (CUS) for NVS navigation and communication payloads.

launch_vehicles.name: LVM3
launch_vehicles.description: Launch Vehicle Mark-3 (formerly GSLV Mk III), India's heavy-lift rocket used for Chandrayaan-2, Chandrayaan-3, OneWeb, and human-rated HLVM3 Gaganyaan flights.

launch_vehicles.name: SSLV
launch_vehicles.description: Small Satellite Launch Vehicle designed for rapid launch-on-demand deployment of mini, micro, and nanosatellites into 500 km planar and SSO orbits.

launch_vehicles.name: Vikram-1
launch_vehicles.description: All-carbon-composite 4-stage small satellite launch vehicle by Skyroot Aerospace featuring solid stages and Raman-1/2 liquid upper engines.

launch_vehicles.name: Agnibaan
launch_vehicles.description: Customizable 2-stage orbital rocket by Agnikul Cosmos powered by 3D-printed semi-cryogenic Agnilet engines; completed Agnibaan SOrTeD suborbital demonstrator.

missions.name: GSLV-F18 / NVS-03
missions.summary: Third second-generation NavIC navigation satellite (NVS-03) carrying L1, L5, and S-band navigation payloads with an indigenous Rubidium Atomic Frequency Standard.

payloads.name: NVS-03 (IRNSS-1L)
payloads.description: Second-generation NavIC spacecraft enhancing regional positioning, navigation, and timing coverage over India and surrounding 1,500 km.

missions.name: GSLV-F17 / EOS-05 (GISAT-2)
missions.summary: Geo-imaging Earth observation satellite (EOS-05) providing near-real-time multi-spectral monitoring of the Indian landmass from geostationary orbit.

payloads.name: EOS-05 (GISAT-2)
payloads.description: High-agility geostationary imaging spacecraft for disaster monitoring, agriculture, and coastal surveillance.

missions.name: PSLV-C62 / EOS-N1
missions.summary: PSLV-XL configuration deploying the EOS-N1 hyperspectral/optical Earth observation primary spacecraft alongside commercial rideshare satellites.

payloads.name: EOS-N1
payloads.description: Advanced Earth observation satellite optimized for coastal, environmental, and defense imagery.

payloads.name: Commercial Rideshare Cluster
payloads.description: Multi-customer auxiliary cubesat and microsatellite batch integrated via NSIL.

missions.name: LVM3-M6 Commercial Heavy-Lift
missions.summary: Dedicated NSIL commercial heavy-lift mission aboard LVM3 deploying next-generation direct-to-device LEO broadband communications spacecraft.

payloads.name: BlueBird Block-2 Communication Satellite
payloads.description: Large phased-array commercial LEO telecommunications satellite launched on LVM3.

missions.name: Gaganyaan Test Vehicle TV-D2
missions.summary: Second abort test flight validating the Gaganyaan Crew Escape System (CES) and Crew Module sea-recovery operations with the Indian Navy.

payloads.name: Gaganyaan Crew Module (TV-D2)
payloads.description: Instrumented uncrewed Crew Module testing parachute deployment and splashdown recovery.

missions.name: Gaganyaan-G1 Uncrewed Orbital Flight
missions.summary: First uncrewed orbital qualification mission of human-rated HLVM3 carrying the Gaganyaan Orbital Module and Vyommitra humanoid robot.

payloads.name: Gaganyaan Orbital Module & Vyommitra
payloads.description: Crew Module + Service Module validating ECLSS life-support systems, avionics, re-entry thermal protection, and Vyommitra telemetry.

missions.name: Gaganyaan-H1 Crewed Orbital Mission
missions.summary: India's inaugural human spaceflight mission launching Gaganyatris into a 400 km circular Low Earth Orbit for a multi-day mission and splashdown return.

payloads.name: Gaganyaan Crewed Orbital Module (H1)
payloads.description: Pressurized crewed spacecraft supporting Indian astronauts with full environmental control and life support.

missions.name: Vikram-1 Orbital Maiden Flight
missions.summary: Skyroot Aerospace's inaugural orbital launch of Vikram-1, demonstrating multi-orbit small satellite deployment by an Indian private company.

payloads.name: Vikram-1 Commercial & University Payloads
payloads.description: Technology demonstration and small satellite payloads aboard India's first private orbital-class carbon-composite rocket.

missions.name: Chandrayaan-4 Lunar Sample Return
missions.summary: Multi-module lunar sample return architecture involving Ascender, Descender, Transfer, and Re-entry modules to bring lunar regolith back to Earth.

payloads.name: Chandrayaan-4 Lander & Ascender Stack
payloads.description: Robotic surface drilling, sample containment, lunar ascent, and orbital docking stack.

missions.name: LVM3-M4 / Chandrayaan-3
missions.summary: Historic mission achieving the world's first soft landing near the Lunar South Pole (Shiv Shakti Point) with Vikram lander and Pragyan rover.

payloads.name: Vikram Lander & Pragyan Rover
payloads.description: Propulsion module, Vikram soft-lander, and 6-wheeled Pragyan rover with ChaSTE, ILSA, APXS, and LIBS payloads.

missions.name: PSLV-C57 / Aditya-L1
missions.summary: India's first space-based solar observatory placed in a halo orbit around the Sun-Earth Lagrange Point L1.

payloads.name: Aditya-L1 Observatory
payloads.description: Seven scientific payloads including VELC, SUIT, SoLEXS, HEL1OS, ASPEX, PAPA, and Magnetometer.

missions.name: Agnibaan SOrTeD Suborbital Flight
missions.summary: World's first flight powered by a single-piece 3D-printed semi-cryogenic rocket engine (Agnilet) and first launch from a private launchpad in India.

payloads.name: Agnibaan SOrTeD Avionics Demonstrator
payloads.description: Validated autopilot, gimballed thrust vector control, and semi-cryogenic propulsion in flight.

isro_centres.name: Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre
isro_centres.specialization: Launch Vehicle Design, Solid Propulsion & Avionics
isro_centres.description: ISRO's lead centre for designing and developing launch vehicles including PSLV, GSLV, LVM3, SSLV, and the Gaganyaan Crew Escape System.

isro_centres.name: U R Rao Satellite Centre
isro_centres.description: Nodal centre for conceptualizing, designing, fabricating, and testing Indian communication, navigation, remote sensing, and planetary satellites.

isro_centres.name: Satish Dhawan Space Centre
isro_centres.specialization: Spaceport, Launch Operations & Solid Propellant Processing
isro_centres.description: India's primary orbital spaceport operating First and Second Launch Pads (FLP/SLP), vehicle integration buildings, and downrange tracking.

isro_centres.name: Space Applications Centre
isro_centres.description: Develops spaceborne transponders, high-resolution optical cameras, SAR radars, and NavIC navigation payloads for Indian spacecraft.

isro_centres.name: ISRO Telemetry, Tracking and Command Network
isro_centres.specialization: Mission Control, Deep Space Tracking & TT&C Ground Stations
isro_centres.description: Operates MOX Mission Operations Complex and the Indian Deep Space Network (IDSN) at Byalalu supporting Chandrayaan, Aditya-L1, and LEO satellites.
